remaining_bottleneck.measured: 146 prepared runs with ~0.8 ms total host submit versus ~235 ms inclusive wait; ChannelMix ~70.7 ms, recurrence ~59.9 ms, attention projections ~45.3 ms
remaining_bottleneck.alternation: Real ChannelMix + norm program alternation adds ~1.11 ms/pair over warmed separate programs; includes scheduling/PDI/cache effects
remaining_bottleneck.weight_traffic: Packed BF16 linear weight stream estimated 2,883,584,000 bytes/token from tile shapes; not a hardware bandwidth counter. Host API transfers remain only embedding/logits.
limitations: Full projection design uses all 16 shim input streams; attempted larger attention-front fusion traded worker parallelism for ports and gained only 0.32%, reverted
Further recurrent normalization rewrite gained 2.07% and introduced extra drift, reverted
Single-core fused recurrence exceeded program memory; accepted three-stage spatial design uses 24 cores
Current installed XRT runlist previously returned ERT_CMD_STATE_ABORT; ordinary runs work. Historical version-specific limitation, not universal unsupported claim

stopping_basis: Current verified resident/dataflow architecture reached a local optimization plateau after successive 0.32%, 2.78%, 2.07% whole-model experiments. Remaining large gain needs a different multi-stage device-program/context scheme or batched prefill; current DMA/program-memory/runtime constraints are documented. This is not a claim of theoretical XDNA2 throughput saturation.
next_three: Unify multi-stage device programs/context, with a minimal C++ compatibility probe before replacing per-stage submissions
Build true multi-token BF16 GEMM prefill with sequential WKV state updates, retaining independent state oracle
Trace device cycles/DMA stalls for ChannelMix and recurrence, then optimize FP32 nonlinear kernels only under explicit unchanged numerical gates
